newsitem.title: USA: CWM to acquire Countrywide unit.
newsitem.headline: CWM to acquire Countrywide unit.

text.p: CWM Mortgage Holdings Inc said Thursday it had agreed to acquire Countrywide Asset Management Corp from Countrywide Credit Industries Inc in exchange for 3.6 million newly issued CMW shares.
CWM said it would become a self-managed real estate investment trust.

The definitive agreement between CWM and Countrywide, and a related registration rights agreement, have been approved by a special committee of independent CWM directors, the CWM board, and the Countrywide board, with only the unaffiliated directors of the companies voting, the companies said.

CWM said it expects the transaction to be presented for approval at its annual meeting, scheduled for May, following the filing of a proxy statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission and a subsequent proxy distribution to CWM shareholders. However, depending on the timing and results of regulatory review, approval of CWM shareholders may instead be sought at a later special meeting, CWM said.

Angelo Mozilo, vice chairman and chief executive officer of CWM and vice chairman and executive vice president of Countrywide, said the deal was considered "fundamentally fair to the shareholders of both companies."
CWM's special committee has retained Dean Witter Reynolds Inc as financial adviser on the transaction, and Countrywide has retained Merrill Lynch & Co.
Dean Witter and Merrill Lynch have rendered opinions to the effect that the deal is fair, from a financial point of view, to both companies, CWM and Countrywide said.
CWM said it has negotiated with its affiliate, Independent National Mortgage Corp, to purchase the rights to that name as well as the related trade name Indy Mac.

CWM said Independent National's board has approved the sale of its name, and CWM's board has approved the change of CWM's name to Independent National Mortgage Corp. The name change is subject to shareholder approval at the CWM annual meeting.

CWM is a real estate investment trust whose businesses include Independent National, which operates a nationwide private mortgage conduit, a subprime mortgage division, and a manufactured housing division. CWM owns all the preferred stock and has a 99 percent economic interest in Independent National.
Countrywide is the largest independent residential mortgage lender and servicer in the U.S..
